features: 3 Lifts inc, Direct Access to Theatre/Concert Hall
Great Transport Links including Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Well presented, lovely apartment, two bedroom, one bathroom & one en-suite shower room. Located on the 8th floor. Situated in a quiet location overlooking the sculpture court within the Barbican art centre, and views over the City. Wood flooring throughout the reception/kitchen. Reception and main bedroom have full height/width glass sliding door/windows leading on to a balcony. Built-in wardrobes. There are three lifts for access along the Crescent. One of the lifts gives you direct access into the theatre/concert hall. 24hr car park attendants/porterage will hold keys and receive packages. Use of resident’s gardens.  Car parking and bike storage by separate negotiation with the City of London.
The Barbican Estate is Grade 2 listed, and the finest achievement of architects Chamberlain, Powell and Bon. It includes the Barbican Arts Centre, cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, theatre, restaurants, bars and cafes. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are close at hand. The Barbican is perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon and Liverpool Street stations (with direct trains to both Heathrow and Gatwick) only a short walk away. Close proximity to the various lines at underground stations Barbican, Moorgate and St Paul's. No onward chain.
Service Charge: 01/04/26 to 31/03/27 Estimated £4,621.
Lease: 150 years from 2010
Ground Rent: £150
